[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T11:32:15Z, by staff] Honeywell Technologies Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year Outlook
Honeywell Technologies announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results and increased its full-year sales guidance, citing strong performance in its first quarter as an independent company.
Honeywell Technologies reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results and raised its full-year sales outlook to a range of $20.0 billion to $20.1 billion. This updated guidance represents an increase from the company's previous expectation of $19.8 billion to $20.0 billion. The company projects organic sales growth of 4 percent to 5 percent for the full year, with an anticipated 5 percent to 6 percent organic growth in the fourth quarter. CEO Vimal Kapur attributed the positive results to strong performance during the company's first quarter operating as a standalone entity following its spin-off.
